scope: Globe entry (NASA layers, terminator on the time slider, unrolls to the Equal Earth atlas) plus one room: the Long Room (Trinity College Dublin), built on the device from a seeded hall kit, with 5 readable Trinity-linked texts, Kells, Durrow and Armagh as catalogue cards, and the Byrne's Euclid living page. Spec: docs/specs/build-spec.md
preview: bun run build && bunx vite preview --port 4173
recheck: jq -r '.criteria[]|"\(.id)\t\(.check)"' data/phase-a.json | while IFS=$'\t' read -r id c; do sh -c "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "passing $id" || echo "failing $id"; done

criteria.what: Largest contentful paint under 3 s (Lighthouse, mobile preset)
Long Room assets 25 MB or less
dist fits Cloudflare Pages: under 20,000 files, none over 25 MiB
criteria.check: test -d dist && test $(fd -t f . dist | wc -l) -lt 20000 && test -z "$(fd -t f -S +25m . dist)"

criteria.what: Every fact the room shows matches a passing evidence row
criteria.check: jq -e --slurpfile F data/facts.json '(.facts|length>0) and all(.facts[]; . as $m | $F[0].facts | any(.lib==$m.lib and .value==$m.value and .status=="passing"))' dist/lib/longroom.json

criteria.what: All 5 Trinity texts built into parts of 200 KB or less
criteria.check: jq -r '.books[]|select(.lib=="longroom" and .tier=="readable-text")|.id' data/books.json | while read -r id; do test -s dist/book/$id/1.json || exit 1; done && test -z "$(fd -t f -S +200k . dist/book)"

criteria.what: Each Trinity text opens, turns to its last page and closes without errors
A book read once reopens with the network off
Kells, Durrow and Armagh shown as catalogue cards, no scan
criteria.check: jq -e '[.shelves[]|select(.tier=="catalog")|.title]|contains(["Book of Kells","Book of Durrow","Book of Armagh"])' dist/lib/longroom.json

criteria.what: Credits list author, licence and URL for every image used
criteria.check: jq -e '(.credits|length>0) and all(.credits[]; .author and .licence and .url)' dist/lib/longroom.json

criteria.what: Every hall parameter has a basis; estimated ones show the label in the UI
criteria.check: jq -e '(.hall|length>0) and all(.hall[]; .basis!=null)' dist/lib/longroom.json && bunx playwright test e2e/estimated-label.spec.ts

criteria.what: Reader usable at 390 px wide: no horizontal scroll, page turn by swipe
Walking the room: p95 frame time 20 ms or less on an M1 MacBook Air in Chrome
Arrow keys turn pages; reduced motion swaps the page turn for a fade
With reduced motion set, the globe fly-in, room entry and Byrne reveal cross-fade in 200 ms or less; dust and cloud drift stop; no smooth-scroll library loads
Globe assets 4 MB or less; poster frame under 60 KB paints first
Worker builds the first Long Room bay before the door opens; time logged on desktop and a mid-range Android
Byrne's Euclid living page: predict, reveal and stamp work; stamp saved under wl.stamps
Headless smoke walks globe, atlas, room and reader; fails on console errors, mixed content, non-2xx same-origin requests or an empty mount
